blends.name: Archer Art + Prize Ticket (Archer)
blends.desc:
Find all 25 pieces to complete the puzzle and claim this bundle!

* Archer Art can be staked in the game to produce gold (staking weight 150).
* Prize Ticket (Archer) can be blended into a limited Legendary Generator it might be blended into a limited workshop.

**Play the game for free at:** https://game.elementalhunters.io
